  James, Human Services and Recreation Supervisor, distributed
  information and spoke on the various upcoming festivities and

  History Month, and responded to questions.

  Vice Mayor Kennedy expressed sympathies and condolences on
  the passing of Mary Eleanor Slay, former City employee and long
  time Pasadena resident.

  apartment complex to be continued as affordable units into the
  future once the property is sold; and spoke in favor of affordable
